items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a band with Kenny Dorham and Art Taylor and Gene Ramey.

ctx.x: Well, that’s a helluva band to be working with. Were they with you at Minton’s?
Actually, we had a band with Kenny Dorham, but Kenny got busted or something. He couldn’t make the date. We had a band with Kenny Dorham and Art Taylor and Gene Ramey.
You were pretty close to Kenny Dorham.
